basic_info.description:
June 20, 2025 Available- Stylishly FURNISHED Studio in Historic Iconic Art Deco Building 
$2,199/month - includes utilities!

Spacious and stylishly furnished studio offers a perfect blend of vintage charm and modern amenities, all in a prime San Francisco location. 

Key Features:
Large Furnished Studio with Views: Enjoy serene views of the garden courtyard.
Prime Location: Walk to the Financial District, theaters, SF Opera, Chinatown, Union Square, and a variety of restaurants offering cuisines from around the world.
Art Deco Gem: Live in one of San Francisco's historic landmarks with stunning architecture and vibrant community spaces. Notable guests include: Vivian Vance, Florence Henderson, and Lauren Bacall!

Apartment Highlights
Living Room: Includes a large expandable desk/dining table, a comfy sofa, and a 43" Roku TV with Netflix for endless entertainment.
Bedroom: Queen-sized bed tucked into a cozy alcove.
Fully Equipped Kitchen: Four-ring stove, oven, fridge/freezer, cookware, utensils, and a stylish wooden dining table that doubles as a workspace.

Bathroom & Laundry: Full tub/shower, ironing board, and convenient app-based washers and dryers in the building.

Home Office Ready: Enjoy a hassle-free work setup with a large desk, high-speed internet (120 Mbps download, 5 Mbps upload), and hardwired connections for maximum speed.

Building Amenities
24/7 Front Desk Security: Ensures a safe and secure environment. Staff assists with deliveries and parcel services.
Lounge Areas: Socialize in the shared lounge with WiFi or relax in the garden courtyard with BBQs.

Skybar: Admire breathtaking views of San Francisco from this rooftop space.
Fully Equipped Gym: Stay active without leaving home.
App-Based Laundry Room: Easy and efficient laundry access.

Parking
On-street parking available but not recommended.
Affordable parking lots just two blocks away.
Rental Terms & Policies

Hamilton Admin Fee: One-time $200 fee required before arrival.
Early Termination Fee: Equal to one month's rent.

Virtual Tours: please request

**MUST HAVE Credit Score of 699 or above. Credit report required. If you do not meet credit score criterium we will allow guarantor with 730+ credit score**

6 months-1 year
